authorship: Reviewer authored phlogopite and its research dossier. Root authored these helper adaptations. This is operational static review, not independent scientific acceptance of the reviewer-owned record.
scope: Eleven current round79 helpers plus imported snapshot library; complete source reading, AST syntax parsing and exact prior-round diffs. No helper top-level execution and no Git/GitHub mutations.

inputs.scope: Imported snapshot-library functions only via run_name=snapshot_library; historical main function is not executed by round79sync.

derivation.scope: Eight literal-adapted helpers only. Commit/hosted-peer/peer-checks assessed separately against exact retained prior source; do not extend derivation claim to them.

assessments: Commit retains strict passed/verdict/base/branch/state/counts/issues checks, strict integer0 excludingbool, duplicate-free exact candidate set and all currentSHA256/symlink checks before explicit allowed-path staging. Its final-gates suffix is current uncorrected round79batch, not round78corrected receipt. No schema/governance path is allowed.

Open PR requires exact local commit/tree, clean package, live main base and owned-branch match before normal push. Post-review requires exact-head positive peer and live head, posts COMMENT only, then reads back exact text/commit; publication metadata is appended externally.

Enqueue requires live active SQUASH/ALLGREEN queue, exact head, all required checks, exact posted COMMENT, actual matching preflight commands/log and fresh main base. Read-before-enqueue is explicitly not atomic locking.

Cleanup verifies actual MERGED/head/tree/parent and issue dispositions, then deletes only exact owned branch with remote lease and local exacthead; it never removes worktree content. Sync-main requires cleanup, allfivehostedruns and freshpostmerge counts/log, unchanged initial original+unrelated snapshots, no tracked/nontracked collision, retained tag and fast-forward only.

Isolated verification uses a new main-only clone and retained annotatedtag; synthetic squash carries exact reviewed tree with trusted soleparent and three topicobjectabsence checks. Postmerge requires actualmergedhead and topicbranchabsence. Coverage enumerates hidden/ignored filesystementries and follows links with cycleprevention, binds canonical IDs/path/exactSHA and verifies all reviewbases.

Hosted peer uses actual --paginate --slurp, duplicate-free complete filecount/set and every tree:path blob, exact hostedhead/base/tree/soleparent/body, requiredworkflow/jobidentity, native owner/history/review and four actualbatch gates, preflightlog/counts/coverage/topicabsence; finalclosinghead/base rechecked. Authorship disclosure correctly names phlogopite.

Postmerge audit preserves issue224 historical pagination provenance correctly labelledRound79, reads exactpublicationmetadata, completefiles/blobs and allfive actual runs/jobs. Success remains separate from freshpostmerge/source science.

Round78 hardcoded chukanovite/clay review assumptions removed. Current native terminal dispositions require explicit previousoccurrences/reason; actual selected scientificreviews and issues must still be independently assessed in the later package audit.
limitations: Cohort helper-config.json does not yet exist at this observation. Actual slugs/counts/issues, finalmanifest, localreceipts, sourcebindings and publication text require later review; no runtime outcome claimed.
Static source checks do not establish permission-independent GitHub availability or future run success. No new tests were run for the inherited guards; AST parsing is not runtime validation.

Ignored caches are excluded from Git commit-candidate scope but included in preservation/inventory where claimed. External targets of unrelated snapshot symlinks are not followed; their target strings/modes are preserved.
